references.text: Abraham was 75 years old when he left Haran. His total lifespan was 175 years, meaning he spent 100 years in the promised land.
Abraham was one hundred years old when Isaac was born. This is a significant moment in Abraham's 175-year life.
Sarah's lifespan is summarized with a similar phrasing: 'The days of Sarah were one hundred and twenty-seven years.' Parallel patriarchal lifespan note.
The direct continuation describing Abraham's death: he breathed his last and died at a good old age, old and full of days.
Isaac's lifespan was 180 years – a parallel patriarchal lifespan summary with similar phrasing.
Jacob's lifespan was 147 years. A third parallel patriarchal lifespan summary following the same pattern.
Hebrews 11:8-10 summarizes Abraham's faith and life as a pilgrim, offering a New Testament reflection on his entire life journey.
Contrast between the line of promise (Abraham) and the natural line (Ishmael) through parallel summaries of their life journeys.
Contextual confirmation where Abraham's age (25:7) supports the description of him as blessed and old (24:1).
